name: bandwhich
description: Real-time network bandwidth monitoring per process and connection

tools.description: Real-time network monitor with process-level bandwidth tracking
tools.usage:
bandwhich # Monitor all network interfaces with process details
bandwhich -i Wi-Fi # Monitor specific network interface
bandwhich -r 500 # Refresh display every 500ms
bandwhich --addresses # Show remote IP addresses and ports
bandwhich --no-resolve # Skip DNS resolution for faster display
